acceptanceCriteria.text: Code-folding uses Monaco NATIVE folding: standard chevron collapse/expand + '...' placeholder for a collapsed region (NOT setHiddenAreas hide-lines).
Foldable regions are the METHOD boundaries - folding collapses a whole method block.
Collapsing an UNCHANGED method-block collapses the corresponding block SYNCED across all 3 editors (Local/Center/Repository); method-blocks containing a change/conflict STAY EXPANDED.
Collapsing a method PRESERVES the scroll position — the editor does NOT jump to line 1 (smooth collapse). (Tron: fold render works via FIX-A+B, but collapse must not scroll-to-top.)

Native Monaco folding (folding:true) + custom FoldingRangeProvider at method boundaries; collapse programmatic via editor.getContribution('editor.contrib.folding').getFoldingModel().setCollapsed (pinned monaco 0.52.2). Chevron + collapsed '…' placeholder — NOT setHiddenAreas.
Unchanged method-block collapse-state mirrored across all 3 (initial + foldingModel.onDidChange propagate, re-entrancy-guarded); spline/gutters reflow after (getTopForLineNumber fold-aware).
Methods overlapping conflicts[] excluded from collapse -> change-methods stay expanded+contiguous (why v2 ribbons stay clean vs v1).

Native fold chevron + '…' are TOUCH-tappable (no hover-only); tap-to-fold/unfold + synced unchanged-collapse work on the mobile viewport across the 3 panes. Gate on device (the setHiddenAreas mobile break is why v2 exists).

GATE (screenshot+behavior, DET-3x) — MUST run on TRON'S REAL DEVICE or a HEADED real-WebKit browser, NOT Playwright chromium-emulating-iPhone (chromium-emulation renders 0 codicon/fold-decoration elements = FALSE-NEGATIVE on the Monaco fold render; that engine artifact caused the whole 'native broken' detour). Assert: diff a shell file -> native fold chevrons at method boundaries + '…' placeholder; unchanged method collapses, change-overlapping method stays expanded; collapse in one pane mirrors to the other 2; scroll stays anchored (no jump to line 1). A green chromium-emulation run MUST NOT be accepted.

Collapse-unchanged fold-sync x3 MUST hold for the LEFT (Local) pane THROUGH and AFTER add(green) blocks. (FIX-A initial render) an unchanged method DOWNSTREAM of a green add-block collapses in ALL 3 panes (L/C/R) at initial render, BEFORE any toggle. (FIX-B mirror) after a green add, toggling a shared unchanged method's fold in one pane mirrors to the other 2 BY SIGNATURE (not index) and stays synced. Downstream 3-pane row-alignment is preserved (0px drift). GATE on real mobile WebKit / Tron device (chromium-emulation false-negatives the fold codicon render).

Methods: foldByMethodBoundaries ddc5ea1c (registerMethodFoldingProvider) / syncNativeFold e64924cb (initial setCollapsed + onDidChange mirror) / keepChangeMethodsExpanded fca7b5f7 (unchangedMethods filter). FLAG: FoldingController is INTERNAL API (Tron-mandated, pinned monaco 0.52.2 - single revisit on any bump). R30.51 setHiddenAreas markers (23b416c2/2d7a0103/9493c08a) superseded, do NOT reuse - native bodies, not renames. MOBILE = touch-tappable, gate on device.
model.mobileBuildNote: Architect 2026-07-19 (design-folding.md v2 ac6d91a6a): MOBILE covered by native design + iPhone-12 gate, no separate derive. 2 items for the EXPERT at build+gate: (a) TAP-TARGET: Monaco native fold chevron is a small gutter glyph -> bump touch hit-area (CSS on folding gutter / larger target on coarse-pointer) so tap-to-fold works on iPhone-12. (b) LAYOUT: if mobile 3-pane is single-pane/stacked (R30.52 mobile P0), collapse-STATE must persist per-editor + stay consistent across pane-switch so 'synced unchanged-collapse' is coherent (fold-state per-editor but identical for unchanged methods). If either non-trivial at the device gate -> architect spins a focused MOBILE derive.

testScenarios._env: Gate on real-WebKit / Tron's device for the RENDER ACs (chromium-emulation shows 0 codicon = false-negative). Logic ACs (fold-state math) may model-proxy on chromium.
testScenarios.foldByMethodBoundaries_2de3411f: Open a 3-way diff of a SHELL file (multiple functions). ASSERT: native Monaco fold-gutter chevrons render AT each method/function boundary; collapsing an unchanged method shows the '…' collapsed placeholder. (RENDER -> real-WebKit.)
testScenarios.keepChangeMethodsExpanded_640f8428: Diff where some methods overlap a conflict and some don't. ASSERT: a method whose range OVERLAPS a conflict[] range stays EXPANDED (no fold control collapses it); a no-overlap (unchanged) method DOES collapse. (Logic; verify via fold-state + render.) | FIX-A (R30.53 device-QA sharpen): at INITIAL render (before any toggle), an unchanged method DOWNSTREAM of a green ADD block collapses in ALL 3 panes incl LEFT(Local); ASSERT no Math.max floor leaves it expanded on the left AND 0px downstream row-drift. Gate real-WebKit / Tron device.
testScenarios.syncNativeFold_b629c015: Collapse an unchanged method in ONE pane. ASSERT: (a) the corresponding method collapses in the OTHER 2 panes (1:1 by seq/name); (b) after collapse the scroll position STAYS ANCHORED — editor does NOT jump to line 1 (AC-preserve-scroll). Repeat expand -> mirrors + anchored. (Sync logic + scroll behavior.) | FIX-B (R30.53 device-QA sharpen): AFTER a green ADD block, collapse a shared unchanged method DOWNSTREAM of the add in the LEFT(Local) pane -> mirrors to Center+Right BY SIGNATURE (not index); ASSERT LEFT-pane parity holds through+after the add AND downstream 3-pane row-alignment = 0px drift. Gate real-WebKit / Tron device.
testScenarios.mobile: On iPhone-12 / real device: fold chevron+'…' are TOUCH-tappable (tap-to-fold, no hover-only); if 3-pane is stacked, collapse-state persists per-editor + consistent across pane-switch.
